title: A Little Fire Inside
old_p1: Some days were tired days for Jeremiah. People did not want the words he carried, and he thought about staying quiet.
But the words would not sit still. They felt like a small warm fire tucked away inside his bones.
'His word was in mine heart as a burning fire shut up in my bones,' Jeremiah said. He tried and tried to hold it in, and he could not.
old_p2: So he opened his mouth and sang instead. 'Sing unto the Lord,' he said. 'Praise ye the Lord.'
When something true and good is tucked inside you, it wants to come out. Let it out, little one. Heavenly Father keeps a warm light burning in you, even on tired days.
p1: Some days were hard for Jeremiah. The people did not want to hear Heavenly Father’s words, and some of them were mean to him. Jeremiah thought about staying quiet.
But the words would not sit still. They felt like a small warm fire inside him.
“His word was in my heart like a burning fire shut up in my bones,” Jeremiah said. He tried and tried to hold it in, and he could not.
p2: So Jeremiah opened his mouth and sang. “Sing to the Lord! Praise the Lord!” he said.
When something true and good is inside you, it wants to come out. Let it out, little one. Heavenly Father keeps a warm light burning in you, even on tired days.
